result.title: End-to-End Differentiable Diffusion Conditioning for Physics-Informed Optimization
result.comment: Initial version submitted to the NeurIPS 2026 main conference pending publication
result.summary: Optimizing high-dimensional physical systems under expensive evaluations and complex constraints is a central challenge in science and engineering. In offline model-based optimization (MBO), methods must improve designs using only a fixed dataset and no test-time access to the true objective. However, existing methods typically suffer from conservatism, unconstrained surrogate exploitation, or function as static inference-time samplers that cannot refine candidates against precise physical objectives. In this paper, we propose Differentiable Diffusion Conditioning (D2C) for offline MBO, which leverages the fact that deterministic sampling makes the reverse denoising chain differentiable with respect to the conditioning signal. D2C turns a frozen conditional diffusion model into an end-to-end gradient-based optimizer by directly optimizing conditioning variables at test time via gradients from frozen surrogate objectives and physics-informed penalties backpropagated through the reverse chain. We implement this idea in a composed proposer-evaluator framework and evaluate it on laser pulse optimization for inertial confinement fusion, sustainable data-center workload scheduling, and four Design-Bench tasks. Our method achieves the strongest results on the two real-world tasks and the best average rank across four Design-Bench tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Differentiable Diffusion Conditioning（D2C）：利用确定性采样使反向去噪链对条件信号可微，在测试时用冻结代理目标与物理约束的梯度直接优化条件变量，把冻结的条件扩散模型转化为端到端梯度优化器，并在激光脉冲设计、数据中心调度与 Design-Bench 上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 该方法线索是把损失梯度沿扩散采样链回传到条件或潜变量以实现测试时优化，可供核查如何用外部目标梯度更新 latent 推理状态，但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理。
